title: Moroccan Chicken Skewers
subtitle: Spiced yoghurt-marinated chicken with mint and lemon
excerpt: Chicken breast marinated in yoghurt, cumin, and warm spices, then roasted or grilled on skewers. The yoghurt keeps the meat moist even at a high heat.
sourceNotes: Based on Moroccan spiced brochette-style chicken. Yoghurt marinade is the standard tenderising approach for this type of skewer.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Marinate for up to 24 hours in the fridge.
recipe.temperatureNote: Fan 200 or gas 7. Or grill on high.

content.text: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes so they do not burn under the grill or in the oven.
Mix the yoghurt, lemon zest, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, garlic, and olive oil in a large bowl. Season well.
Add the chicken pieces and stir to coat. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 220 degrees C. Thread the chicken onto skewers. Lay across a roasting tin so the chicken is elevated.
Cook for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once halfway through, until cooked through and charred at the edges.
Scatter over the mint and serve with flatbread and extra yoghurt.

items.symptom: Chicken is dry in the centre.
items.cause: Overcooked or cubes were cut too small.
items.fix: Use 3cm cubes and check at 12 minutes; use a probe for confidence.

items.symptom: Yoghurt marinade charred heavily before chicken cooked.
items.cause: Oven was too hot or skewers were too close to the element.
items.fix: Tent loosely with foil for the first 8 minutes, then uncover to colour.

items.symptom: Chicken did not develop any char.
items.cause: Oven not hot enough or too much marinade left on the pieces.
items.fix: Shake off excess marinade before skewering and use highest heat.
